newsitem.title: USA: Alexander Haagen shareholders okay sale.
newsitem.headline: Alexander Haagen shareholders okay sale.

text.p: Alexander Haagen Properties Inc Friday said 98 percent of voting stockholders approved Lazard Freres Real Estate Investors LLC's aquisition of a 38 percent fully diluted stake in the company.
The purchase represents a total 57 percent of the outstanding common stock, subject to certain voting rights and a standstill agreement, Alexander Haagen said in a statement.
Lazard Freres aquired its stake at $15 per share for a total $235 million. The shares traded off 1/16 at 16 at midday.
In addition, Alexander Haagen announced the resignation of three directors and the appointments of four new directors nominated by the Lazard Freres group.

Warren Fix, James Hankla and Tom Bradley resigned from the board. Bradley will continue to work with the company in an advisory capacity. The new directors are: Arthur P. Solomon, Anthony E. Meyer, Robert Barnum and Edward P. Fox.
